purpose: Second post-recovery mechanics frontier reconciliation for existing canonical skill identities; distinguishes documented behavior from unresolved exact mechanics and acquisition/reward evidence.

records.name: Brutal Buster
records.documented: Ultimate associated with Broly (DB Super); current repository evidence places it in Broly's Future Saga-era moveset.

records.name: Apocalyptic Burst
records.documented: Ranged Ki Blast Ultimate with a multi-stage burst sequence; existing research preserves its acquisition/classification endpoint.

records.name: Gigantic Rage
records.documented: 200-Ki Strike Super from PQ130; current documentation describes a grab followed by five ground slams and a final hard knockdown. Super Armor is documented specifically for Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan), not as a universal skill property.

records.name: Shooting Strike
records.documented: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super associated with Gamma 1; repository evidence links it to PQ156 and confirms current skill identity/availability.

records.name: Time Skip/Jump Spike
records.documented: Existing evidence identifies the move as a 100-Ki Strike Super from Hit training.

policy.canonical_rule: Canonical skills.json remains authoritative; research and audit artifacts provide evidence only.
policy.preservation: No unsupported exact frames, universal damage constants, hidden conditions, or reward probabilities are promoted.
policy.acquisition_boundary: A PQ/training/shop acquisition statement is not converted into a PQ reward relationship without explicit reward evidence.
policy.result: No canonical field change was justified by this batch; existing bounded mechanics are retained.

next_frontier: Continue with the next unaudited mechanics/acquisition cohort and separately reconcile PQ forward/reverse typed-reward parity.
